jurisdiction_scope: Sri Lanka - Western Province & National Statutory Instruments

sources.title: Urban Development Authority Planning and Development Regulations 2021
sources.issuing_authority: Minister of Urban Development and Housing / Urban Development Authority
sources.applicability_notes: Statutory baseline regulations for low-rise and high-rise developments across all 47 Western Province Local Authorities under UDA Law No. 41 of 1978.

sources.title: City of Colombo Development Plan 1999 (Incorporating Amendments up to 2008)
sources.issuing_authority: Urban Development Authority / Colombo Municipal Council
sources.gazette_number: Approved under Law No. 41 of 1978 Sec. 8F
sources.applicability_notes: Statutory planning scheme controlling Floor Area Ratio (FAR - Form C1) and building setbacks/coverage (Form C2) within Colombo Municipal Council only.

sources.title: Amendment to the City of Colombo Development Plan (1999 & 2008)
sources.issuing_authority: Minister of Megapolis and Western Development / UDA
sources.applicability_notes: Statutory amendment modifying road line definitions, parking norms, and setback rules within CMC limits.

sources.title: Urban Development Authority Declared Urban Areas Map & Register 2024
sources.applicability_notes: Confirms that 100% of the land area across Colombo, Gampaha, and Kalutara districts is designated within UDA Declared Urban Planning Areas.

sources.title: Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation Act No. 52 of 1968 and Amendments
sources.issuing_authority: Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka / SLLDC
sources.gazette_number: Act No. 52 of 1968 / Act No. 35 of 2006
sources.applicability_notes: Statutory reservations alongside designated canals, retention basins, and wetlands in the Colombo Metropolitan Region (4.5m - 10.0m canal buffer).

sources.title: Agrarian Development Act No. 46 of 2000
sources.issuing_authority: Parliament of Sri Lanka / Department of Agrarian Development
sources.applicability_notes: Prohibits construction on classified paddy land without written permission from the Commissioner General of Agrarian Development.

sources.title: Proposal for Introduction of Additional Parking Floors in Residential Buildings
sources.applicability_notes: Draft discussion document proposing bonus floors for parking. Strictly rejected from binding rule application because it was never gazetted.
